Concept.title: Episodic memory, organized by time
Concept.description: Previously keeps a single timeline of your AI interactions instead of scattering them across chat threads. Every conversation, task, and event lives in chronological order — just like your own memory.
Concept.slices: Slices are time-bound snapshots — hours, days, or weeks of activity grouped into cohesive episodes you can browse, search, and revisit.
Concept.strands: Strands weave related slices together across time, connecting the dots between conversations, projects, and ideas that thread through your day.

Recall.title: How recall works
Recall.description: Recall happens in two phases. First, a broad temporal search surfaces candidate slices across your timeline. Then, semantic matching within those slices pinpoints the exact memory you need — without digging through endless threads.

OpenSource.title: Open source, self-host
OpenSource.description: Previously is MIT-licensed and designed to be self-hosted. No cloud lock-in, no telemetry, no surprises. Deploy on your own infrastructure or contribute on GitHub.
